title: Microsoft Edge browser profiles
whyItMatters: Edge profiles can be signed into work or personal accounts, so they reveal which identities were used on this Mac.
source: Chromium browser profile roots on macOS, Edge at ~/Library/Application Support/Microsoft Edge - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/chrome-firefox
notes: Preferences marks each real profile. Cookies and history sit in the same profile folder but are separate rules elsewhere in the catalog.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Edge export favourites from the favourites page, and save any passwords you keep in the browser.
cleanup.signOut: In Edge sign out of the account in the profile settings, so the work or personal account stops trusting this Mac.
steps: Close every Edge window so the profile files are not in use.
Move Microsoft Edge to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Microsoft Edge folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Edge profile on this Mac: favourites, history, cookies, saved logins and extensions.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, View and delete browser history in Microsoft Edge: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/view-and-delete-browser-history-in-microsoft-edge
